_comment: The passkeys page's custom actions (generic passkeys page PRD D3, D4), shipped as a library layer
(composition D1). The classes are CustomActions/*Action.cs in this library; their rights are in
this library's security.json. Labels and the confirmation are actions.<Name>.* in translations.json.
AddPasskey needs the browser's WebAuthn: ng-spark-auth registers 'webauthn.create', and where it
is missing or unsupported the button is shown disabled with the reason.
